m: रिच् cl. 7. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxix, 4) रिणक्ति, रिङ्क्ते cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xxxiv, 10) रेचति; cl. 4. Ā. (cf. Pass.) रिच्यते (ep. also ˚ति; pf. रिरेच, रिरिचे, RV. &c. &c.: रिरिच्याम्, अरिरेचीत्, RV.; p. रिरिक्वस्, रिरिचान, ib.; aor. आरैक्, RV.; अरिक्षि, ib.; Br.; अरिचत्, Kāv.; fut. रेक्ता Gr., रेक्ष्यति, ˚ते, Br. &c.; inf. रेक्तुम् Gr.), to empty, evacuate, leave, give up, resign, RV.; to release, set free, ib.; to part with i.e. sell (‘for’ instr.), ib. iv, 24, 9; to leave behind, take the place of (acc.), supplant, AV.; TS.; Br.; to separate or remove from (abl.), Bhaṭṭ. : Pass. रिच्यते (aor. अरेचि), to be emptied &c., RV.; ŚBr. &c.; to be deprived of or freed from (abl.), Vikr.; BhP.; to be destroyed, perish, R. : Caus. (or cl. 10.Dhātup. xxxiv, 10; aor. अरीरिचत्), to make empty, Daś.; to discharge, emit (as breath, with or scil. मारुतम्), AmṛtUp.; Pañcar.; to abandon, give up, Kāv. : Desid. रिरिक्षति, ˚ते Gr.: Intens. रेरिच्यते, रेरेक्ति, ib.
रिच् [cf. Zd. ric; Gk. λείπω, λοιπός; Lat. linquo, licet; Lith. likti; Goth. leihwan; Angl.Sax. león; Eng. loan, lend; Germ. lîhan, leihen.]
a: रिच् — {vI.v} {c7c} U. (रिणक्ति, रिंक्ते, रिक्त) 1 To empty, evacuate, clear, purge; रिणच्मि जलधेस्तोयं Bk. 6. 36; आविर्भूते शशिनि तमसा रिच्यमानेव रात्रिः V. 1. 8; तिमिररिच्यमानं पूर्वदिङ्मुखमालोकसुभगं दृश्यते V. 3. --2 To deprive of, make destitute of. --3 To separate, divide. --4 To give or deliver up, part with. --5 To bequeath (usually in p. p., see रिक्त). {vII.v} {c1c} {c10c} P. (रेचति, रेचयति, रेचित) 1 To divide, separate, disjoin. --2 To abandon, leave. --3 To join, mix. --Caus. 1 To evacuate, make empty. --2 To discharge, emit (as breath). --3 To leave, abandon.

s: strI, (ric + ktaH । wAp .) tiTiBedaH । sA tu caturTI navamI caturddaSI ca । yaTA, -- “nandA BadrA jayA riktA pUrRA ca tiTayaH kramAt ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ karmmasu tasyA nizeDaviDI yaTA, -- “nandA BadrA jayA riktA pUrRA nAmasadfkPalAH .” na riktA sarvvakarmmasu । iti jyotiHsAraH ॥ “candre cArkakujArkiSukraviyute maDye'TavA pApayoH tyaktvA ca vyatipAtavEDftidinaM vizwiYca riktAM tiTim । krUrAhAyanacEtrapOzarahite lagnAMSake mAnuze ॥ riktAsu viDavA kanyA darSe'pi syAdvivAhitA । SanEScaradine cEva yadi riktA tiTirBavet । tasmin vivAhitA kanyA patisantAnavardDinI ॥” iti dIpikA ॥ “zazWe mAsi niSAkare SuBakare riktetare vA tiTO sOmyAdityasitendujIvadivase pakze ca kfzRetare ॥” iti BujabalaBImaH ॥ “dvAdaSI saptamI nandA riktAsu paYcaparvvasu । balamAyuryaSo hanyAt SiSUnAmannaBakzaRam ॥” iti kftyacintAmaRiH ॥ “pUrvveSAntakasarpamUlarahitezvfkzezvarikte tiTO zazWe mAsi sitendujIvadivase gojYarkza mInodaye । saMprApte paYcame varze aprasupte janArddane । zazWIM pratipadaYcEva varjayitvA taTAzwamIm ॥ riktAM paYcadaSIYcEva sOriBOmadine taTA । evaM suniScite kAle vidyAramBantu kArayet ॥” iti vizRuDarmmottaraH ॥ “pUrvvAgniyAmyaPaRicitraSivAnyaBezu riktAzwamIM vigatacandratiTiM vihAya । dvyaNgAligosamudaye vikujArkivAre SastenduyogakaraRezu halapravAhaH ॥” iti dIpikA ॥ “candrArkayorBavet pUrRA kuje BadrA jayA gurO । buDamandO ca nandAyAM Sukre riktAmftA tiTiH ॥” iti BImaparAkramaH ॥ “sarvvatra kAryye buDajIvaSukrAH kendratrikoRopagatAH praSastAH । tftIyalABArigatASca pApAstiTirviriktA SuBadasya cAhaH ॥” iti dIpikA ॥ “caturTI navamI cEva riktA cEva caturddaSI । Sukre nandA buDe BadrA SanO riktA kuje jayA । gurO pUrRA ca saMyuktA sidDiyogAH prakIrttitAH ॥ buDamandagatA nandA kuje BadrA jayA gurO । BfguriktAmftaM proktaM pUrRA ca ravicandrayoH ॥” iti jyotiHsAgarasAraH ॥ “zazWyazwamIdbAdaSIzu na gacCettridinaspaSi । pUrRimApratipaddarSariktAvamadinezu ca । taTA yamadbitIyAyAM yAtrAyAM maraRaM Bavet ॥” iti satkftyamuktAvalI ॥
m: रिक्ता (आ), f. (scil. तिथि) N. of the 4th, 9th, or 14th day of the lunar fortnight, VarBṛS. (cf. रिक्तार्क)
a: रिक्ता — N. of the fourth, ninth, and fourteenth days of a lunar fortnight.

m: रिक्तार्क m. a Sunday falling on one of the Rikta days, Cat.
रिक्ती in comp. for रिक्त.
रिक्ती—√ कृ P. -करोति, to make empty or void, Kāv.; to leave, quit, Hcar.; Kād.; to remove, take away, Bhaṭṭ., Sch.; to steal, MW.; to get back, recover, ib.
रिक्ती—कृत-हृदय mfn. emptied or deprived of heart, Pañcat.

s: klI, (ric + ktaH .) SUnyam । vanam । iti medinI । te, 50 ॥
tri, (ric + ktaH .) nirGanam । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (SUnyam । yaTA, manuH । 8 । 405 । “BARqapUrRAni yAnAni tAryyaM dApyAni sArataH । riktaBARqAni yatkiYcit pumAMsaScAparicCadAH ॥”)
v: na॰ rica--kta । 1 Sunye 2 vane medi॰ । 3 nirarTake ca tri॰ Sabdara॰ । svArTe ka । tatrEva tri॰ ।
m: रिक्त , रिक्थ &c. See col. 2.
रिक्त mfn. (accord. to Pāṇ. vi, 1, 208, also रिक्त) emptied, empty, void, AV. &c. &c.
bared (as an arm), Megh.
hollow, hollowed (as the hands), Cat.
poor, indigent, MBh.; BhP.
idle, worthless, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 8, Sch.
(ifc.) devoid or destitute of, free from, without, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
रिक्त m. (in augury) N. of one of the four wagtails which serve for omens, VarBṛS.
of a man, Pat.
रिक्त n. an empty place, desert, wilderness, wood, L.
a: रिक्त — p. p. [रिच्-क्त] 1 Emptied, cleared, evacuated. --2 Empty, void; devoid or deprived of, without. --3 Hollowed (as hands). --4 Indigent. --5 Divided, separated. --6 Worthless, useless. --7 Unloaded; see रिच्. --क्तं 1 An empty space, vacuum. --2 A forest, desert, wilderness. --Comp. --अर्कः a Sunday falling on one of the रिक्ता days. --पाणि, --हस्त a. empty-handed, bringing no present (of flowers &c.), अहमपि देवीं प्रेक्षितुमरिक्तपाणिर्भवामि M. 4.

m: रिक्त—भण्ड n. an empty vessel, Mn.; VarBṛS. having no vessels or effects, W.
रिक्त—गुरु See Pāṇ. vi, 2, 42.
रिक्त—हार w.r. for रिक्थ-ह्˚, q.v., BhP.

v: tri॰ rikto DanAdiSUnyo hasto yasya । 1 nirdDane, BUridAnAdinA 2 vyayitaDane ca ।
m: रिक्त—हस्त mfn. empty-handed, bringing no present, Pañcad.; Kathās.
carrying away no pr˚, Cāṇ.

s: tri, (rikta + kan .) SUnyam । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 56 ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 8 । 404 । “paRaM yAnaM tare dApyaM pOruze'rdDapaRaM tare । pAdaM paSuSca yoziSca pAdArdDaM riktakaH pumAn ॥”)
m: रिक्तक mfn. empty, void, L.
unladen, unburdened, Mn. viii, 404.
a: रिक्तक — a. See रिक्त.

k.v: निर्णिक्तं शोधितं मृष्टं निःशोध्यमनवस्करम्. अवसारं फल्गु शून्यं तु वशिकं तुच्छरिक्तके॥

m: रिक्त—कृत् mfn. making empty, causing a vacuum, VarBṛS.
रिक्त—कुम्भ n. pl. ‘(the sound of) an empty vessel’, (prob.) empty or senseless language, AV.
रिक्त—मति mfn. empty-minded, thinking of nothing, BhP.
रिक्त—पाणि mfn. empty-handed, having nothing in the hand, Āpast.
bringing no present, ib.; MBh. &c.
रिक्त—ता f. emptiness, vacuity, Śiś.; Kathās.
रिक्वन् m. = स्तेन, a thief, Naigh. iii, 24.
a: रिक्वन् — m. Ved. A thief.

m: रिक्षा f. a nit (= लिक्षा), L.
a mote in a sunbeam, W.
a: रिक्षा — 1 A nit (लिक्षा). --2 The mote in a sun-beam.

m: रिल्हण w.r. for बिल्हण.
रिम्फ् (cf. √ रिफ्) cl. 6. P. रिम्फति to hurt, kill, Dhātup. xxviii, 30.
रिम्फ n. the zodiac, W.
रिम्ब् See √ रिण्व्.
रिमेद m. = अरि-मेद, L.

v: baDe tu॰ pa॰ saka॰ sew । rimPati arimPIt rimPata

m: 1. रिप् (cf. √ लिप्; only pf. रिरिपुः), to smear, adhere to (loc.), RV. (cf. रिप्त); to deceive, cheat, ib.
2. रिप् f. injury, fraud, deceit, RV.
an injurer, deceiver, enemy, ib.
the earth (?), RV. iii, 5, 5; x, 79, 3 (Sāy.; cf. Naigh. i, 1).

s: klI, lagnApekzayA dbAdaSarASiH । yaTA, -- “karmmasTAnaYca daSamaM KaM meSUraRamAspadam । CidrAKyamazwamaM sTAnaM ripPAKyaM dbAdaSaM smftam ॥” tatra cintanIyaM yaTA, -- “prAptyAyAvaTa cintayedBavagfhe ripPe'Ta mantrivyayO sOmyasvAmiyutIkzitErupacitistezAM kzatistvanyayA ॥” iti jyotistattvam ॥
v: pu॰ rinPa--ac pfzo॰ । lagnApekzayA dvAdaSe KyAne jyo॰

m: रिप्र n. dirt, impurity (lit. and fig.), RV.; AV.
रिप्र m. N. of a son of Ślīṣṭi, Hariv. (v.l. विप्र)
रिप्र mfn. vile, bad, W.
a: रिप्र — a. Bad, vile. --प्रं 1 Sin. --2 Dirt, impurity.

s: tri, pApavAhakaH । yaTA, -- “kravyAdamagniM prahiRomi dUram । yamarAjyaM gacCatu ripravAhaH ॥” iti BavadevaBawwoktakuSaRqikApadDatiH ॥ “ripraM pApaM vahatIti ripravAhaH .” iti tawwIkAyAM guRavizRuH ॥ “sa prahitaH kravyAdagniH yamarAjyaM gacCatu yamasya rAjyaM prati vrajatu । kimBUtaH ripravAhaH ripramiti pApanAma । ripraM pApaM vahati nASayati ripravAhaH .” iti vAjamaneyasaMhitABAzye mahoDaraH । 35 । 19 ॥ “ripravAhaH ripraM pApaM tasya voQA so'gniH yamarAjYaH yamo rAjA yezAM tAn yamarAjakAn anyapradeSAn gacCatu prApnotu .” iti fkBAzye sApaRaH । 10 । 16 । 9 ॥)
m: रिप्र—वाह mfn. removing impurity or sin, RV.
रिप्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to seize or grasp, Vop.
रिप्त mfn. smeared, adhering to (loc.), RV. i, 162, 9.
रिप्त—लेप m. what sticks or adheres (to the hand), ĀpŚr.

s: puM, (anizwaM rapatIti । rapa vAci + “rapericcopaDAyAH .” uRA॰ 1 । 27 । iti kuH ikAraScopaDAyAH । “riPa katTanayudDanindAhiMsAdAnezu । ‘IzeH kiYca .’ uRA॰ 1 । 14 । iti bAhulakAdupratyayaH । ripati kecit paWanti । tatra bAhulakAdeva kakArasya pakAraH । riPati mozaRArTaM yuDyate hinasti vA nindyate ca satpuruzEH .” iti niGaRwuwIkAyAM devarAjayajvA । 3 । 24 । 4 .) SatruH । ityamaraH । 2 । 8 । 10 ॥ (yaTA, hitopadeSe । “nakaScit kasyacinmitraM na kaScit kasyacidripuH । kAraRAdeva jAyante mitrARi ripavastaTA ॥”) SarIrasTazaqripavo yaTA । kAmaH kroDaH loBaH mohaH madaH mAtsaryyaSca । taTA hi । “AsTAya yogamavajitya ca vErizawkamAvaDya cendriyagaRaM manasi prasanne ॥” ityAdi tantrasAre BuvaneSvarIstotram ॥ * ॥ corakanAmaganDadravyam । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ lagnApekzayA zazWalagnam । tatparyyAyaH । zawkoRam 2 ripumandiram 3 । yaTA, -- “DIsTAnaM paYcamaM jYeyaM yAmitraM saptamaM smftam । dyunaM dyUnaM taTAstAKyaM zawkoRaM ripumandiram ॥” api ca । “sunIcage'stage'pi vA riporgfhesTitA grahAH । vfTA PalaM prakIrttitaM samastameva sUriBiH ॥” anyacca । “arAtivraRayoH zazWe cAzwame mftyuranDrayoH । vyayasya dbAdaSasTAne vEparityena cintanam ॥” iti jyotistattvam ॥ (Druvaputtrasya SizweH puttraH । yaTA, harivaSe । 2 । 14-15 । “tasmAtSizwiSca BavyaSca GruvAt SamBurvyajAyata । SizwerADatta sucCAyA paYcaputtrAnakalmazAn ॥ ripuM ripuYjayaM puzpaM vfkalaM vfkatejasam ॥” yadoH puttraH । yaTA, BAgavate । 9 । 23 । 20 । “yadoH sahasrajit krozwAnaloripuritiSrutAH ॥”)
v: pu॰ rapa--un pfzo॰ । 1 SatrO amaraH । 2 coranAmaganDadravye rAjani॰ । jyotizokte lagnApekzayA 3 zazWasTAne ca । dehisTezu zawsu 4 kAmakroDAdizu । “kAmaH kroDaSca mohaSca mAtsaryyaM madaloBakO । dehisTA ripavaSceti” purA॰
m: रिपु mfn. deceitful, treacherous, false, RV.
रिपु m. a deceiver, cheat, rogue, ib.
an enemy, adversary, foe, Mn.; MBh. &c.
(in astrol.) a hostile planet, VarBṛS.
N. of the 6th astrological house, ib.
a gall-nut, L.
N. of a son of Ślīṣṭi, Hariv.
of a son of Yadu and Babhru, Pur.
a: रिपुः — [रप्-उन् पृषो˚ Uṇ. 1. 26] 1 An enemy, a foe, an opponent. --2 A hostile planet. --3 N. of the sixth astrological house. --4 Ved. A cheat, rogue. --Comp. --घातिन्, घ्न, --जय, --निपातिन्, --सूदन a. killing or vanquishing foes. --भवनं, --स्थानं N. of the 6th astrological house.

k.v: उदासीनः परतरः पार्ष्णिग्राहस्तु पृष्ठतः। रिपौ वैरिसपत्नारिद्विषद्द्वेषणदुर्हृदः॥

m: रिपु—भवन, n. (ib.) or रिपु—भाव, m. (Cat.) N. of the 6th astrological house.
रिपु—भय n. fear or danger from an en˚, ib.
रिपु—घातिन् mfn. slaying an en˚, L.

s: strI, (ripuM hantIti । hana + RiniH .) latAviSezaH । kucui iti BAzA । yaTA, “kucikA bahuvistIrRA kuYcikA ripuGAtinI ॥” iti SabdacandrikA ॥
v: strI ripuM hanti hana--Rini । (ku~cui) latABede Sabdaca॰ । 2 SatruDAtake tri॰ ।
m: रिपु—घातिनी (इनी), f. Abrus Precatorius, W.
रिपु—घ्न mfn. killing an en˚, VarBṛS.
रिपु—ं-जय mfn. conquering a foe, Cāṇ.; BhP.
रिपु—ं-जय m. N. of several kings, Hariv.; Pur.
of an author, Cat.

v: tri॰ ripuYjayati ji--Kac mum । 1 SatrUjayini, 2 nfpaBede pu॰ ।

m: रिपु—बल n. an en˚, army, VarBṛS.
रिपुहण mfn. killing enemies, MBh.
रिपु—काल m. the god of death (as invoked against enemies), Jātakam.
रिपु—मल्ल m. N. of a king, Śatr.
रिपु—मर्दिन् mfn. harassing or destroying enemies, Hariv.
रिपु—निपातिन् mfn. causing an enemy to fall, destroying a foe, MBh.
रिपु—पक्ष mfn. being on the side of an en˚
रिपु—पक्ष m. an en˚, Mcar. vii, 0/1 (perhaps w.r. for -पक्षे, ‘on the side of the en˚’).
रिपु—राशि m. the 6th astrological house, VarYogay.
रिपु—राक्षस m. N. of an elephant, Kathās.
रिपु—रक्त n. an en˚'s blood, Pañcat.
रिपु—रक्षिन् mfn. preserving from an en˚, MW.
रिपु—स्थान n. the 6th astrological house, Cat.
रिपु—सूदन mfn. destroying en˚, R.
रिपु—ता f. enmity, hostility, Hit.
रिपु—वश mfn. subject to an en˚
रिपु—वश—त्व n. subjection to an en˚, VarBṛS.
रिपु—वर्जित mfn. freed from an en˚, MW.
रिरी f. yellow or pale brass, prince's metal, L. (cf. रीरी, रीति).
a: रिरी — Yellow or pale brass.

m: रिरंसा f. (fr. Desid. of √ रम्) desire of pleasure or of sexual enjoyment, lasciviousness, lustfulness, MBh.; Kathās.; Pur.
a: रिरंसा — 1 Desire to be pleased or to sport. --2 Desire of pleasure or sexual union, lustfulness, libidinousness.

m: रिरंसु mfn. wishing for sport or sexual pleasure, wanton, lustful, Hariv.; Kāv.; Suśr.
wishing to enjoy (any one acc.) carnally, HPariś.
रिरक्षिषा f. (fr. Desid. of √ रक्ष्) the desire to watch or guard or protect or maintain, Hariv.
(ungrammatical form रिरक्षा, BhP.)
रिर˚क्षिषु mfn. desiring to watch &c., MBh. (˚क्षु incorrect, BhP.)
रिरमयिषु mfn. (fr. Desid. of Caus.) wishing to cause or give (sexual) pleasure, Uṇ. i, 99, Sch.
रिरिचान See above under √ रिच्.
रिरिक्वस् See above under √ रिच्.

a: रिरिक्षत् — m. Ved. An enemy.

m: रिरिक्षु See below.
रिस्सु m. N. of a poet, Cat.
रित् mfn. (√ रि, री) running, flowing, RV. vi, 37, 4 (Sāy. = गन्तृ).
रितक्वन् m. a thief, Naigh. iii, 24 (v.l. for तक्वन्).

s: i vraje । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-para॰saka॰-sew .) i, riRvyate । vrajo gatiH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: gatO BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ sew idit । riRvati ariRvIt ।

m: रिवक w.r. for रवक.
रिटि f. (only L.) the crackling or roaring of flames
a musical instrument
black salt (cf. भृङ्गि- and भृङ्गी-र्˚).
a: रिटिः — 1 The crackling of flames. --2 Black salt. --3 A musical instrument. --4 N. of an attendant of Śiva; cf. भृंग(गे)रिटिः.

k.v: बाहुलेयस्तारकजिद्विशाखः शिखिवाहनः। षाण्मातुरः शक्तिधरः कुमारः क्रौञ्चदारणः। शृङ्गी भृङ्गी रिटिस्तुण्डी नन्दिको नन्दिकेश्वरः। कर्ममोटी तु चामुण्डा चर्ममुण्डा तु चर्चिका॥

m: रिय Nom. P. ˚यति (fr. रै), Pat. (cf. √ 1. री).

1. रिष् (cf. √ रिश्) cl. 1. 4. P. (Dhātup. xvii, 43 and xxvi, 120 v.l.) रेषति or रिष्यति (ep. also रिष्यते; aor. रीढ्वम्, TĀr. अरिषत् Subj. रिषाथ, p. रीषत् or रिषत्, RV.; अरेषीत् Gr.; fut. रेषिता, रेष्टा, ib., रेषिष्यति, ib.; inf. रेषितुम्, or रेष्टुम्, ib.; Ved. inf. रिषे, रिषस्), to be hurt or injured, receive harm, suffer wrong, perish, be lost, fail, RV. &c. &c.; to injure, hurt, harm, destroy, ruin, RV.; AV.; Bhaṭṭ.; Caus. रेषयति (aor. अरीरिषत्; Ved. forms रीरिषीष्ट or रिरिषीष्ट, रिरिषेः, रिषयध्यै), to hurt, injure, harm, cause to miscarry or fail, RV.; AV.; TBr.; MBh.; (Ā. रीरिषीष्ट), to fail, meet with misfortune or disaster, BhP. : Desid. रिरिक्षति (RV.; रिरिषिषति or रिरेषिषति Gr.), to wish to injure or harm (cf. √ रिश्) : Intens. रेरिष्यते, रेरेष्टि Gr.
2. रिष् f. injury or an injurer, RV. (for, -रिषे, रिषस् See under √ 1. रिष्).
a: रिष् — {c1c} {c4c} P. (रेषति, रिष्यति, रिष्ट) 1 To injure, hurt, harm; तस्येहार्थो न रिष्यते Mb.; तेन यायात्सतां मार्गं तेन गच्छन्न रिष्यते Ms. 4. 178. --2 To kill or destroy; Bk. 9. 31. --3 To give offence. --4 To perish, be injured ({c4c} P.). --5 To meet with a reverse or misfortune. --6 To fail.
रिष् — f. An injury, hurt, harm.
